title: AI-Powered Portfolio Website
description: Designed and developed a fully responsive personal portfolio website from scratch using React and Vite, featuring modular component architecture, CSS modules for scoped styling, and a custom JSON-driven data layer that makes content updates seamless. Integrated an AI-powered chat assistant using OpenAI GPT-4o-mini routed through a Netlify serverless function — allowing visitors to interactively query my experience, skills, and projects in real time. Deployed on Netlify with continuous deployment from GitHub.

title: AI Portfolio Assistant
description: Built and deployed an AI-powered chat assistant directly into this portfolio site. Recruiters and hiring managers can ask natural language questions about my experience, skills, and projects and get instant accurate answers. Built with React, OpenAI GPT-4o-mini, and a Netlify serverless function that proxies API calls securely — keeping the API key out of the browser. Fully live in production.

title: Instacart Analytics — dbt & PostgreSQL
description: End-to-end analytics engineering project built on the public Instacart dataset — 3.4M orders, 206K users, 50K products. Designed a production-grade four-layer dbt model architecture (Staging, Intermediate, Core Marts, Marketing Marts) on PostgreSQL, standardizing KPIs like reorder rate, basket size, and order frequency segments. Enforced data quality with 60+ schema tests and custom singular tests that caught real data issues including duplicate order IDs and null handling for first-order records. Replicated real analytics engineering patterns used in delivery marketplace data teams.

title: Python Data Quality Validation Framework
description: Built a lightweight, modular data quality framework in pure Python and Pandas — inspired by Great Expectations but with zero heavy dependencies. Designed six reusable Expectation classes covering null rates, uniqueness, accepted values, range checks, referential integrity, and row count reconciliation. Applied against the Instacart dataset (3.4M orders, 50K products) as a pipeline pre-flight gate, catching real data issues including 0.03% duplicate order IDs and out-of-range cart position values before downstream mart writes. Outputs structured JSON validation reports with pass/fail summaries and failure samples. 18 unit tests at 100% pass rate.

title: Instacart Medallion Lakehouse — Databricks & PySpark
description: Built a production-pattern Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion pipeline on Databricks Community Edition using PySpark and Delta Lake, applied to the Instacart dataset at scale — 3.4M orders, 33M order-product line items, 206K users, 50K products. Implemented schema enforcement at ingestion, window-function deduplication, referential integrity checks via Spark left-anti joins, and row count reconciliation gates that halt the pipeline automatically on data drift. Gold layer delivers analytics-ready fact and dimension tables including user behavior segments, product popularity tiers, and department KPI aggregations. CI runs pytest on every push via GitHub Actions.
